answer: Before any retry, check the provider transaction state and the idempotency key on the existing attempt. If the provider says ACCEPTED or SETTLED, never create a new settlement, reconcile the existing one instead. If the provider state is unknown or contradicts ours, pause the retry worker and escalate to the AcmePay contact. Done means the ledger shows exactly one settlement for the order.

content.applicability: AcmePay provider settlement flow in payment-platform
prerequisites: The existing settlement attempt and its idempotency key can be located
steps: Check the provider transaction state for the existing attempt
Check the idempotency key on the existing attempt
Reconcile the existing attempt instead of creating a new one
stop_and_escalate: Do not create a new settlement when the provider reports ACCEPTED or SETTLED
Pause the retry worker and escalate to the AcmePay contact when the provider state is unknown or contradictory
success_checks: The ledger shows exactly one settlement for the order
